description: List assignment groups (categories like Homework, Exams) in a course. Use `include=assignments` to nest assignments under each group; other includes add submission, overrides, score_statistics, etc.

assignment_ids.description: When combined with include=assignments, restrict nested assignments to these IDs

exclude_assignment_submission_types.description: Exclude assignments whose submission_types match any of these values

grading_period_id.description: Scope to a specific grading period

include.description: Extra fields to include (Canvas include[] param)

override_assignment_dates.description: Apply assignment overrides to due/unlock/lock dates

scope_assignments_to_student.description: Limit assignments to what the current student can see

name: list_assignment_groups
title: List Assignment Groups
